mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.order_id AS orderId, e.evaluator_id AS evaluatorId, COALESCE(ep.nickname, eu.username) AS evaluatorName, e.target_id AS targetId, e.score, e.content, e.create_time AS createTime FROM trade_evaluation e JOIN sys_user eu ON e.evaluator_id = eu.id AND eu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile ep ON eu.id = ep.user_id AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE e.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
